integrity: Self-contained Python 3 verification of twenty-two Picard curve pairings, exact negative-support enumerations, independent orbit-union counting, full 720-permutation verification by a separate star/triangle algorithm, and eleven pairwise distinct numerical fingerprints. All embedded file digests and byte counts are recomputed and checked during packaging.
scientific_limitations: The two chamber counts classify the Frobenius cycle partition of the six-point conic blow-up, not individual surface isomorphism classes. The geometric support count 1898, root count 648, and combinatorial support criterion are prior work; only the complete eleven-type arithmetic fixed-support classification and its sharp two-coordinate distinction are assessed here. Earlier equivalent arithmetic calculations may exist.
title: Two chamber counts detect Frobenius on one-nodal cubic resolutions
